gallery.title: Tutorial: give a reel your brand
gallery.description: A tutorial reel for RenderWeld users: how an agent applies a brand theme to a project in three steps (list themes, set theme, render), with code and a stepper. Uses the optional Remotion engine, which needs your own Remotion licence.
gallery.prompt: A tutorial reel for RenderWeld users: how an agent applies a brand theme to a project in three steps (list themes, set theme, render), with code and a stepper. Default theme, 18 seconds.
